answer: Mechanism: Simultaneous Physical-Entropy Quorum. Each agent is bound to a hardware sensor node. Spatially separated beacons in karst, spiral, and reef testbeds issue unpredictable challenges; the node must return signed local seismic/pressure samples inside a millisecond window. Fresh ambient entropy prevents replay, and one operator cannot be co-located at multiple sites at once. Attack cost: redundant physical sites, synchronized sensors, and continuous maintenance—far above spawning software sybils.
